description: Same-day (0DTE) options on a stock token, each series its own ERC-20 token that closes at 4:00 p.m. New York today: the stock's price, the time to the close, Borro's share of a sale, and every series made for today with its id, token, strike, how many are open and for sale, the best price and the cheapest offers. Also the past series still waiting to be settled, and with wallet what that wallet holds, sold, has on sale and can collect. Covered only: sellers lock the whole collateral, so there are no liquidations.

symbol.description: A stock with same-day options, by its ticker, like NVDA

wallet.description: Optional: a wallet's address, to add what it holds, sold and can collect
